about: Upper limits of the bundles' sizes (tools/ci_checks.py sizes, CI). Set about 10 % above the sizes of 2026-10-24 (kisi.html 2.87 MB, kisi-examples.html 6.50 MB, kisi.mjs 2.22 MB); raised on 2026-10-25 with the Prepare PCB page and the via models of feat/return-groups (kisi.html 3.19 MB, kisi-examples.html 6.95 MB, kisi.mjs 2.41 MB), again about 7 % above. A change that makes a bundle larger on purpose raises the limit in the same commit.
